thread:
maria: kicking off bring-up for asia-southeast1 GPU cluster. putting the smoke/validation runbook here — pinging infra + oncall for quick review :wave:
ajay: thanks. can you paste the minimal smoke steps? curious about quotas and network egress limits first.
jess: planned capacity = 16 GPUs per zone x 4 zones (A10G equiv). initial reserved for dedicated = 50%. canary traffic = 5% -> 15% depending on rollout.
maria: noted. minimal prechecks done: project quotas bumped, service accounts provisioned, VPC peering verified. leaving checklist in thread.

maria: BRIEF CHECKLIST (high level):
- quotas: GPUs, IPs, NICs validated with cloud support
- networking: routes, peering, firewall rules, NAT throughput
- auth: node SA + KMS access tested
- infra: instance templates, startup scripts, GPU drivers validated
- runtime: container image pulled, runtime config (batching, timeout) set
- monitoring: dashboards and alerts wired (p95 latency, pod restarts, GPU temp)
- canary: traffic shift policy and fallback to smaller model configured
- cost gates: soft limit alerts, autoscaler budget cap in place

ajay: add runbook for health probes and smoke tests (examples):
```
# cluster health
curl -sS https://api.asia.example.com/health | jq .status
# expected: {"status":"ok","live":true}

# pod status
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide

# quick GPU check
kubectl -n inference exec -it $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv

# smoke load (local)
python tests/smoke_load.py --url https://api.asia.example.com/generate --model small --rps 3 --duration 60
```
\njess: SLO gates to validate during canary: p95 latency < 1200ms for 512-token requests, error rate < 0.5% (5xx + timeouts), 99.9% availability over 30m window. If any gate fails -> rollback to prior region and drain.
tim: add KV cache warmup step: preseed popular prefixes (chat sessions) to avoid cold-start latency spike. script: `kubectl exec job/cache-warm -- ...`

maria: telemetry sanity: verify traces show downstream runtime spans, token counts, and batching metrics. dashboard links: https://grafana.redwood/inference/asia (post-provision)

deploy-bot: started pool-create job 8423 for asia-southeast1-gpu — status: IN_PROGRESS

sre-bot: ALERT: node gpu-a-3 failed driver healthcheck (GPU driver mismatch). Marking node Unready.
ajay: thx bot. action: cordon node, redeploy driver daemonset to that zone, re-run `nvidia-smi` check.
jess: if driver mismatch persists, fallback to host-level fallback: route canary -> smaller model variant in other zone, open incident if >3 nodes affected.

maria: cost gating — we put a billing soft cap at $X/day for initial 48h. ops-lead will approve any overage. also enabled per-pool budget alerts.

ops-lead: confirmed budget alerting and escalation path. if soft cap hit, autoscaler will reduce node count, and canary routing will drop to 0%. urgent escalation: call paging list + #incidents.

maria: handoff plan: once all smoke tests pass and SLOs green for 30m, we'll post final sign-off here and tag ops-lead + oncall. then flip canary to 10% for 2h, then 50% for 1h, then full. each step requires manual ack.
ajay: final verification steps before sign-off:
- end-to-end request -> get model output sanity check (sample prompts)
- p95 latency measurement script run: `python tools/measure_p95.py --target https://api.asia.example.com --tokens 512 --qps 5 --duration 180`
- trace sampling to ensure KV cache hits > 60% after warmup
- confirm no cross-zone bandwidth spikes exceeding provisioned egress

maria: adding rollout checklist to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/blob/main/asia-southeast1-runbook.md (WIP)

tim: note about quotas/costs: preemptible/spot eviction rate expected ~5% in region X. ensure retry logic on client side and fallback to dedicated pool for critical traffic.
jess: also validate per-token cost calc: run synthetic to estimate tokens/sec and projected hourly cost -> compare to budget.

maria: ok team, I'm going to run the smoke scripts now. will update with PASS/FAIL and metrics. ping me for live help. :rocket:

(18m later)
maria: SMOKE PASS: health ok, 3/3 zones healthy, canary runtime pods healthy, single node driver issue fixed by redeploy. p95=780ms, errors 0.12%, kv hit=68%. rolling to 10% now.

ops-lead: ack. monitoring watchers in place. continue canary steps per runbook.

(2h later)
maria: Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% completed with no regressions. closing this thread, moving docs to runbooks repo and tagging release. :white_check_mark:
